literal_meaning: মুখ থেকে স্রোতের মতো (stream from the mouth)
figurative_meaning_en: A torrent of quarrelsome words or a stream of speech
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে রাগে মুখতোড় করে কথা বলতে শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He started speaking in a torrent of words out of anger.
In the debate, his stream of speech wouldn't stop.
note: Refers to uncontrolled or rapid verbal expression, often in conflict.
